cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: early alkyl ether sulfate (Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2) buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3, no second reinforcing anionic or reset surfactant; C1 sets this pattern to moderate. Oily-scalp 'klärend' positioning is not a deep-cleansing/reset claim and claims cannot assign cleansing (3.2).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Anti-Fett / 'klärende Formel' oily-scalp intent could be read as reset intent that C1 excludes

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; the only substantive conditioning route is Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #6 listed after the preservative Sodium Benzoate #5; Panthenol #11 and Glycerin #16 are late humectants; no silicone, fatty alcohol or lipid.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: a cationic guar is present and could be read as one meaningful system (moderate)

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (one late cationic guar), persistence low, resetCapacity moderate (SLES/betaine base). One light polymer can remain low per the §6 anchor; no silicone, oil payload or fatty alcohol.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: single light polymer, no persistent payload
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate needs one meaningfully persistent system or interacting routes; none present

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: name and every source position the product as 'Anti-Fett' for 'schnell fettende Kopfhaut' (oily-root role, which §7.1 places under clarifying); SLES/betaine chassis with no rich conditioning is compatible. Not scalp_active, whose §7.1 meaning names sensitive/anti-dandruff needs.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: cleansing is only moderate (C1); oily-scalp could also be read as a targeted scalp need (scalp_active)
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula: plain SLES/betaine, light, compatible with oily-root role. Claim: dominant Anti-Fett in name. Resolved to clarifying.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: Panthenol moisture and 'Problemhaut/Neurodermitis' tolerability statements are not distinct positioning with an independent formula route; disease-basis-care claims are out of scope.

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: explicit 'Für die tägliche Haarwäsche geeignet' (manufacturer) and cleansingStrength is moderate (not strong); trigger is conjunctive and met.
usageRole.counterSignal: if cleansing were strong, oily-root intent would make it alternating

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: primary positioning is oily scalp; tolerability claims ('Problemhaut', basis care for Neurodermitis/Psoriasis) are disease-adjacent and not an E2 sensitive/itchy claim on the manufacturer page; 'schützt vor Reizeffekten' appears only in retailer copy. Formula carries Menthol #14, Mentha Arvensis Leaf Oil #15 and citrus oil #12 cooling/essential-oil exposure.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C low, not high). T6: no not_suited to lift. T4: W neighbor none; C neighbor moderate keeps coarse acceptable -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-OILY: E2 oily claim 'Anti-Fett' in product name plus 'schnell fettende Kopfhaut' (E1 high); formula gate cleansing moderate, W low (not high), C low (not high) -> pass. Sensitive: no manufacturer E2 claim (retailer-only 'Reizeffekten' is low E1) and scalpComfortTarget not_targeted -> no target, no S-FAIL. S-FOCUS not applicable to oily.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: cleansingStrength moderate -> regular, equal to oily bucket expectation. I3: neighbor strong would yield clarifying (with alternating + clarifying focus) which is not the expected intensity -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false ('klärend' is not a D1 lexicon term; directions allow daily use). D2 not met.

uncertainties: C1/§4: C1 excludes products with 'reset/deep-cleansing intent', and the strong anchor names 'oily-root architecture', but §3.2 forbids claims from assigning cleansing. Resolved: oily-scalp intent is not deep-cleansing intent and the architecture is plain SLES/betaine -> moderate (neighbor strong).

§7.1: oily-scalp positioning fits both 'clarifying' (oily-root role) and 'scalp_active' (targeted cosmetic scalp need). Resolved to clarifying because §7.1 names oily-root under clarifying explicitly.
E3: no Parfum declared but essential oils present; prominence cut at Sodium Benzoate #5, so Panthenol #11 is not prominent (only relevant had a sensitive gate been tested).
